sources.title: pH-sensitive binder design with Proton-PottsMPNN
sources.snippet: Here we present Proton-PottsMPNN, a sequence-design model that explicitly represents the protonated and deprotonated states of histidine, aspartate and glutamate as distinct sequence tokens.

sources.title: Proton-PottsMPNN - Tamarind Bio
sources.snippet: Redesign a binder so that it binds its target at one pH and releases it at another. Place protonatable centres (histidine, aspartate, glutamate) where they do the most to switch binding. Return a spread of designs trading predicted stability against pH-selectivity
